decision_conditions: The operations come within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, thereby not requiring planning permission.

Please note that this certificate is granted for the outbuilding to be used for as a playroom, gym, storage area and shower room would be incidental to main dwelling and as described on the submitted plans. It must only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of 301 Brentwood Road, Romford and not for any trade or business including meetings nor as living accommodation. Should business including meeting or living accommodation use be intended, an application for full planning permission must be applied for and permission granted before such use could occur. The use of outbuildings as living accommodation is not typically deemed acceptable therefore it is important the outbuilding is only used for the purposes as listed above.

This certificate provides confirmation that the development is lawful.  You should also check whether the development requires separate Building Regulation consent. Information is available on the Building Control webpages via http://www.havering.gov.uk/Pages/Category/Building-control.aspx?l1=200252 and the team is available between 9am and 10am Monday to Friday via 01708 432700.

This applicant should note that this decision relates only to the development as shown on the drawings submitted with this application and the description of the proposal. It is noted that a rear outbuilding has already been constructed. The Certificate hereby approved certifies only that the proposed development, as shown on the drawings submitted with this application, would be lawful and does not confirm whether the structure that has already been erected is lawful. Should the applicant require confirmation that the structure, as built, is lawful then a separate application pursuant to Section 191 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 should be sought.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for proposed rear shed to add a Playroom and a Gym along with a storage area and a shower room
